title: Where Do We Go From Here // Keep Rising

top_liked.text: Many people will have an existential crisis.  They will need to deal with that feeling and move forward with their new found understanding of the world around them. Most may keep certain superstitions because it soothes them.  Your thoughts @DaranteLaMar
